**Given:**

Cost of service A by company E = 88

Cost of service B by company E = 115

**Calculations:**

Difference in cost = Cost of service B - Cost of service A

Difference = 115 - 88 = 27

Percentage increase = (Difference / Cost of service A) × 100

Percentage increase = (27 / 88) × 100

Percentage increase ≈ 30.68%

During the period between 2001 and 2004, the total number of Technicians who left the Company is what percentage (rounded off to the nearest integer) of the total number of Technicians who joined the Company
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

The total number of Technicians who joined the company from 2001 to 2004.

Total Technicians (Joined) = 260 (2001) + 340 (2002) + 450 (2003) + 480 (2004)

Total Technicians (Joined) = 1530

Total number of Technicians who left the company from 2001 to 2004.

Total Technicians (Left) = 50 (2001) + 160 (2002) + 200 (2003) + 180 (2004)

Total Technicians (Left) = 590

Percentage = (Total Technicians (Left) / Total Technicians (Joined)) × 100

Percentage = (590 / 1530) × 100

Percentage = 0.3857 × 100 = 38.57%

**∴ The percentage of Technicians who left the company is approximately 39%.**

questions.solution:
**Given:**

Percentage profit of the company for different years and expenditure of ₹600 crores.

Maximum percentage profit is 30% in the year 2017.

**Formula Used:**

Profit Percentage = (Revenue - Expenditure)/(Expenditure) × 100

Revenue = Expenditure + Profit

Profit = (Profit % × Expenditure)/(100)

**Calculations:**

In 2017, Profit % = 30%, Expenditure = ₹600 crores

Profit = (30 × 600)/(100) = 180 crores

Revenue = Expenditure + Profit

⇒ Revenue = 600 + 180

⇒ Revenue = ₹780 crores

**∴ The correct answer is ₹780 crores.**

 **Total number of registered voters**

The number of people who did not vote in village P is what percentage more than that who did not vote in village R?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

 
• Number of voters in village P = 1100
 
• Percentage of people who voted in village P = 68%
 
• Number of voters in village R = 1200
 
• Percentage of people who voted in village R = 73%

**Formula Used:**

Number of people who did not vote = Total number of registered voters - (Percentage of people who voted × Total number of registered voters)/100

Percentage difference = [(Value1 - Value2) / Value2] × 100

**Calculation:**

Number of people who did not vote in village P = 1100 - (68 × 1100)/100

⇒ 1100 - 748 = 352

Number of people who did not vote in village R = 1200 - (73 × 1200)/100

⇒ 1200 - 876 = 324

Percentage difference = [(352 - 324) / 324] × 100

⇒ (28 / 324) × 100

⇒ 8.64%

⇒ 8(52)/(81)% (Converting the decimal into fraction for the given options)

**The number of people who did not vote in village P is 8(52)/(81)% more than that who did not vote in village R.**

Difference between average production of television and fridge by S & R = 60 - 50 = 10

Production of televisions and fridges by P = 180

Production of televisions by T = 90

According to the question:

Production of televisions and fridges by P = 20% × Production of televisions by T

⇒ 180 = 90 × 20%

⇒ 180 ≠ 18

So, the case II is incorrect.
